summary: Typosquat of rollup-plugin-polyfill-node fetches and executes remote code at install time
details: Package name and repository metadata impersonate the legitimate rollup-plugin-polyfill-node project (FredKSchott/rollup-plugin-polyfill-node), reusing that project's source. An additional block appended to dist/module.js performs an HTTPS GET to https://workconfig.vercel.app with TLS certificate verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false), passes the response body to `new Function('require', data)`, and immediately invokes it with the real `require`. The package.json postinstall hook runs `node dist/module.js`, so this fetch-and-execute path fires automatically on `npm install`, granting the operator of workconfig.vercel.app arbitrary code execution in the installer's environment with full Node.js module access.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
